messages:
Maya: kicking off a focused canary probe for eu-west next week. plan: 5% traffic for 24h, then 20% if no negative signals. @Kevin can you run the heatmap query and share by EOD?
Kevin: ack — will run and attach charts. what SLOs should we gate on? p95 latency, error rate?
Maya: p95_latency < 250ms and error_rate < 0.5% as primary gates. also watch generation cost per req.
Sam: we need a clear rollback window and fallback variant. ops should be able to flip quickly.
Olivia: propose fallback -> model-x-small-quant + token-rate-limit 50r/s. add circuit-breaker: if 5xx > 0.5% sustained over 5m, auto-fail to fallback.
Deploy Bot: Deployment scheduled: canary:eu-west on 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC. link: https://deploys/redwood/4951236789
Maya: sample flag config for the launch: 
```json
{"flag":"eu_canary_v1","slices":[{"region":"eu-west","percent":5,"duration":"24h","criteria":["p95_latency<250","error_rate<0.5"]}],"ab_tests":[{"name":"prompt_v2_vs_v2b","cohort_pct":50}],"fallback_variant":"model-x-small-quant"}
```
Kevin: heatmap query I'll run: `SELECT region, SUM(requests) AS reqs, p95(latency) AS p95 FROM telemetry WHERE tag='canary' GROUP BY region;` will push results to #dashboards and attach.
Natasha: ops notes: add explicit playbook steps: 1) flip flag to off, 2) update routing to fallback, 3) invalidate cache if needed, 4) notify customer-ops and oncall. Also document expected cut times.
Sam: during canary we also want an internal A/B on prompt templating. within the 5% slice do a 50/50 split prompt_v2 vs prompt_v2b so we can measure quality delta. tag events with cohort=prompt_v2.
Olivia: +1, and add tracing tag `kv_cache_status` so we can check warmup impact on p95.
Maya: question for product: include Dedicated and Private customers in canary or exclude? leaning to exclude until we hit 20% stability to avoid SLA surface risk.
Kevin: agree on excluding dedicated customers initially. we'll scope telemetry to public-traffic only.
Natasha: kill-switch timing: ops can cut globally in ~15s if flag is central, region-only cut ~45s. will add both paths to the runbook.
Olivia: reminder: fallback must be compatible with streaming RPCs — add a quick integration smoke: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n https://inference.eu-west/model-x-small-quant/stream`
Maya: owners summary:
- Maya (product): rollout owner
- Kevin (data): heatmap + dashboard
- Natasha (ops): runbook + kill-switch
- Olivia (runtime): fallback + perf limits
- Sam (pm): A/B experiment design
Kevin: I'll post heatmap results as soon as query runs (estimating by 4951236805).
Deploy Bot: Canary started 4951236808
Sam: received heatmap — initial 5% slice looks stable on latency and errors. proposing move to 20% at 2026-03-26T12:00Z unless anyone objects.
Olivia: no objections, I have perf limits in place and will monitor KV cache warmup.
Maya: I'll draft the preflight checklist and update the playbook today. tagging doc owners. :thumbsup: 
Kevin: shared dashboard link: https://dashboards/redwood/canary/4951236789 (added cohort filters).
Natasha: ops checklist added to runbook with exact rollback commands and escalation contacts.
Maya: closing thread — final action: I will create the rollout ticket with owners and timings. thanks team
